title: 第18章 与天战！ 冲击元婴之境。 不成元婴，便身死道消！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
这一刻，他追求长生的目的，已经发生了，根本性的，改变。

    以前，他求长生，是为了，永远地，享受这人间的无上权柄。

    而现在，他求长生，是为了，自保！

    他天真地认为，只要自己，也成了仙，或许，就有了，能与那个恐怖的皇叔，平等对话，甚至，是抗衡的，资格。

    他要用尽一切办法，去寻找，那条，通往超凡的道路。

    不仅仅是为了活得更久。

    更是为了，能活下去！

    从此以后，汉武帝刘彻，变得，愈发的多疑，也愈发的，矛盾。

    一方面，他以前所未有的热情，投入到了求仙问药的事业之中。

    他重用方士，祭祀神明，耗费巨资，建造宫观。

    他派人，东至大海，寻找蓬莱。

    西出玉门，探访昆仑。

    他想找到，任何，与“神仙”有关的，蛛丝马迹。

    另一方面，他又对这些方士，充满了，极度的，不信任和戒备。

    他设立了专门的机构，去审查每一个方士的来历，去甄别他们所说的，每一句话的真伪。

    但凡，有任何，欺骗和夸大的行为，他都会毫不犹豫地，将其，处以极刑。

    他的后半生，都活在了这种，既极度渴望，又极度恐惧的，矛盾心态之中。

    他渴望长生，渴望获得那种，超凡的力量。

    他又恐惧，那个，可能已经获得了这种力量的，皇叔刘安。

    淮南的那片，方圆百里的死域，成了他心中，永远无法抹去的，噩梦。

    他终其一生，都在搜集着，各种奇闻异事，都在寻找着，那个，可能依旧存在于世间的，皇叔的踪迹。

    这份深入骨髓的戒备与恐惧，伴随着他，直至离世。

    而淮南王刘安的真正下落。

    以及，那片，在史书上，被讳莫如深地，记载为“天降异象，百里赤地”的淮南死域的真相。

    也成为了，一个，跨越了王朝更迭，无人能解的，千古谜团。

    永远地，留存在了，这悠悠的历史长河之中。
content_en:
At this moment, his purpose of pursuing immortality has undergone a fundamental change.

    In the past, he sought immortality in order to enjoy the supreme authority in this world forever.

    But now, he is seeking immortality to protect himself!

    He naively believed that as long as he became an immortal, he might be qualified to talk to that terrifying uncle on an equal footing, or even compete against him.

    He will use all means to find the path that leads to the extraordinary.

    It’s not just about living longer.

    Even more so, to survive!

    From then on, Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, Liu Che, became more and more suspicious and contradictory.

    On the one hand, he devoted himself to the cause of seeking immortality and medicine with unprecedented enthusiasm.

    He made great use of alchemists, offered sacrifices to gods, and spent huge sums of money to build palaces and temples.

    He sent people east to the sea to look for Penglai.

    Go west out of Jade Gate and visit Kunlun.

    He wanted to find any clues related to "gods".

    On the other hand, he was full of extreme distrust and wariness towards these alchemists.

    He set up a special organization to examine the origins of each alchemist and screen the authenticity of every word they said.

    As long as there is any deception or exaggeration, he will not hesitate to punish them with death.

    For the rest of his life, he lived in this contradictory mentality of extreme desire and extreme fear.

    He longs for immortality and that kind of extraordinary power.

    He was also afraid that the emperor's uncle Liu An might have obtained this kind of power.

    The dead zone in Huainan, a hundred miles in radius, became a nightmare in his heart that could never be erased.

    Throughout his life, he has been collecting all kinds of anecdotes, looking for traces of the emperor's uncle who might still exist in the world.

    This deep-seated vigilance and fear stayed with him until his death.

    And the true whereabouts of Huainan King Liu An.

    And, the truth about the Huainan Dead Territory, which has been kept secret in history books, is recorded as "a vision coming from the sky, a hundred miles of red land".

    It has also become an eternal mystery that no one can solve across the dynasties.

    Forever, it remains in this long river of history.
title_en: Chapter 18 Battle with the sky! Attack the realm of Nascent Soul. If you don't become the Nascent Soul, your body will die and your Tao will disappear!
